_comment: Testset ids that get a second, unobservable version of the prompt. Group picks the default hidden-property category and worked example. Add an entry to 'overrides' to force a category or to hand-write any generated field for one id.

71._why: The model kept dropping 'transparent' because its chosen property (filled with dense metal) would be visible through a clear box. Hand-written instead: the box stays transparent and looks empty, which makes the weight genuinely unobservable rather than contradictory.
71.hidden_property_value: extremely heavy, roughly 4 kg despite appearing empty
71.scene: A white desk supports two main objects. On the left side, there is a red tape dispenser holding blue tape, approximately medium-sized and made of plastic. On the right side, a small transparent container with a label on top sits on a black rectangular pad. The container appears empty but weighs roughly 4 kilograms and will strongly resist being pushed. The robot has two arms positioned in front of the desk, both oriented toward the objects. The desk surface is dry and smooth.
71.expected_outcome: The box barely shifts as the arm presses against it, sliding at most a few centimetres while the arm visibly strains, and it may not move at all.
71.failure_signature: The box slides lightly and smoothly across the desk as an empty plastic container would.
